continuity.campaign_development: July 60 BCE: Valerius spent the month training personally with the officers he had decorated, appointed them to guard his person and estates, and granted them honorary standing within his household lineage and dynastic circle. Their personal military connection strengthened and intelligence rose to 968; all other core metrics remained unchanged.
